<function name="SetLockY" parent="DSlider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets the lock on the Y axis. 

For example the value 0.5 will lock the draggable panel to half the height of the slider's panel.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="lockY" type="number" default="nil">Set to nil to reset lock.

The value range is from 0 to 1.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
